title: crm
subHeroTitle: Custom entity databases, dynamic fields, and omnichannel pipeline intelligence
subHeroDesc: Build custom databases for contacts, accounts, and deal pipelines with 11+ field types, interactive kanban and spreadsheet layouts, omnichannel webhooks, native email outreach, AI meeting transcript BANT extraction, and 360° prospect record hubs.

sections.title: Custom entity architecture with 11+ dynamic field types
sections.desc: Construct multi-tenant databases for Contacts, Companies, and Deals with rich field types, strict validation rules, header field creation, inter-database relations, and custom blueprints.

gridItems.title: Custom Databases & Blueprint Templates
gridItems.desc: Create independent multi-tenant databases tailored for People (Contacts), Companies, Deals, or any custom entity, with customizable icons, colors, descriptions, space assignments, and pre-built templates.

gridItems.title: 11+ Rich Dynamic Field Types
gridItems.desc: Define properties using Text, Multiline, Number & Currency (with symbol & decimal formatting), Date/Range, Select & Multi-Select (with color-coded badges), Email, Phone, URL (with favicons), Boolean toggles, User Assignments, and Record Relations.

gridItems.title: Field Constraints & Column Header Creation
gridItems.desc: Enforce Required Fields, Unique Value Constraints to eliminate duplicate emails or phone numbers, custom field reordering, column visibility controls, and instant field creation directly from table headers.

gridItems.title: Inter-Record Relational Linking
gridItems.desc: Establish cross-database relationships linking contacts directly to company accounts and active deal pipelines (Contact → Company → Deal), manageable via a dedicated Related Records sidepane.

sections.title: Multi-view pipeline boards, advanced query filters, and spreadsheet calculations
sections.desc: Manage deal pipelines across interactive Kanban boards, high-density spreadsheet views, and stage lists with multi-tier sorting, nested AND/OR filters, group-by headers, and footer calculation rows.

gridItems.title: Interactive Kanban & Stage Duration Engine
gridItems.desc: Drag and drop deal cards between pipeline stages while tracking stage entry timestamps (stage_entered_at), duration in stage, Closed-Won and Closed-Lost stage automation rules, and customizable card property visibility.

gridItems.title: High-Density Spreadsheet & Custom Views
gridItems.desc: Perform inline cell editing, column resizing, drag-and-drop column reordering, and real-time input validation, while saving multiple custom views per database with pre-configured filters and layouts.

gridItems.title: Nested Query Filters & Multi-Tier Sorting
gridItems.desc: Construct advanced search queries with nested AND/OR conjunction groups using type-aware operators for text, numbers, dates, and select badges, combined with multi-tier sorting rules (Primary, Secondary, Tertiary).

gridItems.title: Table Aggregation & Group-By Engine
gridItems.desc: Compute bottom-row table calculations (Sum, Average, Min, Max, Count, Unique Count) for numeric and currency columns, and group records dynamically by select properties or owners with collapsible headers.

sections.title: Omnichannel lead ingestion, spreadsheet imports, and native email outreach
sections.desc: Capture leads from embedded web forms, Meta Lead Ads, WhatsApp, and telephony webhooks. Import spreadsheets with auto-mapping, and send emails natively via Gmail and Zoho OAuth.

gridItems.title: Omnichannel Lead Ingestion & Webhooks Hub
gridItems.desc: Capture website form submissions using copy-paste embed snippets, ingest Meta Lead Ads with Conversions API (CAPI) feedback, process WhatsApp Business messages, and log telephony call status callbacks.

gridItems.title: Multi-Format Import & Auto-Field Mapping
gridItems.desc: Bulk import records using .csv, .xlsx, .xls, or .ods files with intelligent header auto-mapping, on-the-fly custom field creation for unmapped columns, and pre-import row validation.

gridItems.title: Native Gmail & Zoho Mail OAuth Outreach
gridItems.desc: Authorize team email accounts directly via OAuth without third-party tools, using an in-app email composer to send emails with attachments directly from any contact record.

gridItems.title: Automated Activity Logs & CSV Export
gridItems.desc: Automatically record sent emails and prospect communications in the immutable Activity Timeline, and export filtered CRM databases and custom view layouts to CSV with one click.

sections.title: AI sales meeting BANT extraction, smart deduplication, and 360° record hubs
sections.desc: Transcribe sales calls to auto-extract BANT criteria, merge duplicate leads with side-by-side comparison, manage 5-tab record hubs, and sync CRM pipeline metrics directly to your main dashboard.

gridItems.title: AI Sales Meeting Bot & BANT Extraction
gridItems.desc: Integrate Recall.ai / Meeting Baas to transcribe sales calls automatically, extracting BANT (Budget, Authority, Need, Timeline) highlight cards directly into prospect CRM records.

gridItems.title: Smart Deduplication & Merge Drawer
gridItems.desc: Detect duplicate contact and company records automatically across databases, using a side-by-side review drawer to inspect, resolve conflicts, and merge duplicate leads cleanly.

gridItems.title: 360° Record Command Center & 5-Tab Hub
gridItems.desc: Inspect leads in full-page or sidepane view across specialized tabs: Overview (properties & touchpoints), Activity Timeline, Notes, Tasks, and Files, with automatic domain favicon enrichment.

gridItems.title: Smart Dashboard CRM Pipeline Sync
gridItems.desc: Display active deal counts, pipeline stage breakdowns, win rates, and total revenue on the KeilHQ main dashboard, synced cross-module with Tasks, Motion Pages, and Meeting Recordings.

capabilitiesTitle: Relational lead intelligence. Complete pipeline control.
capabilitiesDesc: Connect contacts, accounts, deal stages, and webhooks in a unified multi-tenant database built for modern sales execution.
checklistDesc: KeilHQ CRM unifies custom entity databases, dynamic fields, AI meeting intelligence, and omnichannel outreach into a single, high-performance sales hub.

Inter-Record Relational Linking: Link contacts directly to company accounts and deal records (Contact → Company → Deal) with a dedicated Related Records sidepane.,
Interactive Kanban & Stage Duration Engine: Drag-and-drop deal cards between stages while tracking stage_entered_at timestamps, stage duration, Closed-Won/Lost rules, and card settings.,
High-Density Spreadsheet & Saved Custom Views: Edit cells inline with input validation, drag-and-drop column reordering, and save custom view configurations per database.,
Nested Query Filters & Multi-Tier Sorting: Build complex AND/OR search logic with type-aware operators for text, numbers, dates, and select badges alongside multi-tier ASC/DESC sorting.,
Table Aggregation & Collapsible Grouping: Compute bottom-row table calculations (Sum, Average, Min, Max, Count, Unique Count) and group records dynamically by select fields or owners.,
Omnichannel Lead Ingestion & Webhooks: Capture website leads via embed snippets, Meta Lead Ads with CAPI feedback, WhatsApp Business Cloud webhooks, and telephony call status callbacks.,
Bulk Spreadsheet Import & Auto-Mapping: Bulk import .csv, .xlsx, .xls, and .ods files with automated header mapping, on-the-fly custom field creation, and pre-import validation.,
Native Gmail & Zoho OAuth Outreach: Authorize team email accounts via OAuth to send emails with attachments directly from contact records with automated activity logging.,
AI Sales Bot BANT Extraction & 360° Record Hubs: Transcribe sales meetings to extract Budget, Authority, Need, and Timeline insights into 5-tab record hubs with Smart Dashboard widgets.
